description.value:
Trigger A PC leaves area B1

Effect The blood rend unleashes a terrifying psychic emanation. All creatures in area B must attempt a @Check[will|dc:16] save, with the following results. The trap then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Fleeing] for 1 round.

details.description: A crimson, spherical rend in space roils with arcane lightning. The surface boils and drips a steady flow of blood.
details.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:17], @Check[nature|dc:17], @Check[occultism|dc:17] or @Check[religion|dc:17] (trained) while within 10 feet to close the rend; additional DC 17 (trained) skills based on aided civilians; or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Dispel Magic] (1st rank; counteract DC 15); three total successes are required to disable the blood rend.

publication.title: Starfinder Society Scenario #2-01: The First Cut

details.routine:
(3 actions) The trap shoots one crimson lightning bolt per action at a hostile creature within 90 feet (at different targets, if possible), dealing @Damage[1d4[electricity]] damage and @Damage[1d4[mental]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic]).

Each creature that was dealt mental damage can choose to embrace the blood rend's murderous impulses; if they do, they double the mental damage they took and become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Quickened] 1 for 1 round. The additional action can be used only to Strike or Stride toward an enemy creature. The trap loses one action for each successful disable check.

On the third round and every 3 rounds thereafter, the blood rend creates 1 bloodspawned screecher in an unoccupied space within 15 feet, which joins the battle.
